name: Rule of Cool
description: You hold the Rule of Cool. Physics bends slightly around you to let you do things the "cool" way despite impossibility, Style AND Substance baby. You can snatch a bullet from the air and send it back, walk away from an explosion unfazed, perform mid-fight tricks without disadvantage, and similar feats; doing things the cool way comes naturally to you. (Does not affect your stats or level of skills.)
